positions.title: Associate Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Gathered and graphed metrics pertaining to pools of test and development environments that helped the team deliver better developer productivity by sizing pools correctly
• Improved an API that created and maintained instances on Amazon Web Services which were used as test and development environments for application developers
    • Created cost-cutting solutions to various inefficiencies within the API
    • Tested and verified changes to the API to ensure smooth patches and updates while ensuring functionality
• Updated environments and pushed changes through the pipeline to production for other developers

positions.title: Product Testing Intern
positions.description:
• Completed testing of Aquos Crystal cell phone using a variety of programs and scripts and assisted with new product launch in August, 2014 (http://www.sharpusa.com/ForHome/Mobile.aspx)
• Developed scripts that automated testing and logged all phone processes during testing using Python
• Updated programs in JavaScript and C# that automated tests on handheld device to optimize testing
• Served as correspondent between Sprint, Sharp Japan, and software developers to ensure clear communication and timely completion of phone

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
• Tested portable inertial sensors and its potential as a way to quantitatively evaluate balance
    • Verified the inertial sensors’ superiority and increased accuracy when compared to previous testing methods
• Conducted studies analyzing the effects of different footwear on inertial sensors 
• Analyzed and interpreted collected data and presented implications and significance of results
